facts.text: "Korben, this chicken is very good. I will have another one, and so will you."
facts.why: Leeloo never says this. It is in quote marks and signed Leeloo, so it reads as a film line. Her real lines are short, like her fifth element speech.
facts.fix: Me fifth element, supreme being. Me protect you.

facts.why: In the film the Multipass is shown as Leeloo's, and Korben calls her Leeloo Dallas Multipass. The plot page I read does not mention the Multipass at all, so I could not confirm which of them holds it.

facts.text: The Fhloston Paradise dinner during the Diva's song.
facts.why: Attached to the chilli garlic crab. The Diva sings at her concert, which the Mangalore attack interrupts. The plot page I read does not describe a dinner during the song.
facts.fix: The Fhloston Paradise opera night, until the Mangalores crash it

facts.text: She eats like she's never eaten before.
facts.why: Attached to the drumsticks. Leeloo has just been revived, so a hungry line fits, but the plot page I read has no eating scene, so I could not confirm it.
facts.fix: Leeloo's first meal, learning human food

vibe.verdict: The airline idea suits Fhloston Paradise, but the colours are dark and plain next to the film's orange and neon.
